verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.reducto.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of links to markdown doc pages. Individual docs are served as agent-readable .md files (parse, classify, CLI, MCP server, upload, studio), and a machine-readable openapi.json is also available, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
